start.greeting: ⚔️ {game} The whole world map is split into sectors. Play for your city and clan, earn coins and capture territory! Tap the button below to open the game.
help.text: {game} /start — open the game /newclan — create a clan from your channel or group /help — help /terms — terms /privacy — privacy /paysupport — payment support
terms.text: This is an entertainment game. In-game coins have no monetary value and cannot be withdrawn. Telegram Stars purchases only grant in-game benefits.
privacy.text: We store only your Telegram ID, name, username and game progress. Data is not shared with third parties.
paysupport.text: For payment questions, message the administrator: describe the purchase and its date. We reply within 48 hours.
